name: Single Slit Diffraction
description: Wave packet diffracting through a single wide slit
notes: Slit at x=85 (1/3 of grid, NOT half - wave needs time to spread)
Wide slit (50 units) so diffraction pattern is visible
Large wavepacket width (35) ensures enough passes through
Slow momentum (0.2) - wavefunction velocity is HALF the momentum value
Sensor line near right edge (x=220) to capture full pattern
1400 time steps so centroid reaches right edge, not just middle

potential.description: Barrier at x=80-90 with single opening at y=103-153 (50 units wide)

wavepacket.notes: Start left side, move right. Large width for broad wavefront

boundary.notes: Absorb reflections on left, let wave exit right

rendering.notes: Fixed sensor scale shows signal buildup over time
